unihiker-k10-arduino v0.9.4

- Added cross-platform `compile-ota` script for optimized build & OTA upload (supports macOS/Linux and Windows).
- Improved environment setup instructions, including detailed China CDN usage and best practices for fast BSP downloads.
- Documented how to enable official Arduino CLI build cache and incremental builds for faster repeated compilation.
- Updated command and workflow documentation to clarify usage of new scripts and caching options.
- Removed deprecated file (`skill-card.md`); various internal enhancements to scripts and documentation.

unihiker-k10-arduino v0.9.3

- Added official support and instructions for Arduino CLI build cache configuration to dramatically speed up repeated Arduino compiles for K10.
- Introduced new `compile-ota.sh`/`compile-ota.ps1` convenience scripts for optimized compile & one-shot OTA upload (macOS/Linux/Windows).
- Updated documentation: clearly recommend using `build_cache.*` not legacy cache flags, and reorganized setup section for easier K10 onboarding.
- Improved common issues and quick reference sections, including tips for fast incremental compiles and cache troubleshooting.
- Removed outdated or duplicate documentation files (e.g., `skill-card.md`).
- Revised upload and script usage documentation for clarity and completeness.
Initial release: Arduino CLI toolkit, upload scripts, API docs
